heading: Policy provisions
lead: Provisions for cash, loan, paid-up, and extended values, dividends from gains and savings, refund of unearned premiums, and such other provisions as may be found to be reasonable and practicable may be provided for in the policy of insurance from time to time by regulations promulgated by the Secretary.

notes.heading: Amendments
notes.text: 1991—Pub. L. 102–83 renumbered section 706 of this title as this section and substituted “Secretary” for “Administrator”.
